description: Rename a campaign, ad squad or ad. Previews unless confirm=true. For several items at once pass ids instead of the single id: Find-and-replace inside the names of up to 20 campaigns, ad squads or ads. Previews unless confirm=true. Use to rename one campaign, ad squad or ad. For many at once pass ids with find and replace instead of id and new_name.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

entity.description: What to act on: campaign, adsquad or ad (ad squads are Snapchat's ad sets).

find.description: Text to look for in the names.

id.description: Id of the item named by entity. Get it from snap_list_campaigns, snap_list_adsquads or snap_list_ads.

ids.description: Ids of the items to change, at most 20. Get them from the matching matching list tool.

new_name.description: Name for the copy or the new name for the item.

replace.description: Text to put in its place.

name: snap_rename
